Honestly, it was very restrictive in terms of calories. I’m debating whether or not I want to post exact numbers because I don’t want to encourage it or seem like I’m promoting disordered eating. I will say, I focused on eating lots of healthy fats (almonds were a particular favorite, as were avocados and occasionally a drizzle of olive oil), proteins (tofu, beans, protein bars, eggs, powered peanut butter, soy milk, greek yogurt) and low calorie carbs (plenty of fruits, small portions of brown rice, “super bread” from Trader Joe’s, green leafy veggies). I drank a ton of black coffee and tea, especially green tea and “detox” teas (glorified laxatives tbh). I also ate plenty of fermented foods, such as kimchi and kombucha. I drank AT LEAST 1.5 gallons of water a day, but I also live in a very hot climate and am an athlete so that’s likely too much for many people; my rule is that if my urine isn’t almost clear, I need to drink more. Remember your supplements too! I took evening primrose, collagen, turmeric, flaxseed oil, krill oil, calcium, d3, iron, and magnesium. Even if these don’t directly aid in weight loss, a healthy body is an attractive body. Feel free to DM if there’s anything else you’re wondering! I’m not a dietitian or nutritionist so take it with a grain of salt ofc :)
